# TableView.dev

> 100% Private In-Browser Data Workbench, Institutional Financial Engine, and Client-Side Media Compression Studio powered by WebAssembly. Zero server uploads, zero data egress.

## Overview
TableView.dev is an open, private web application running institutional debt calculations, DuckDB SQL analytics, and media compression completely client-side in the user's browser. Files and financial data are never uploaded to any remote server or cloud service.

## Core Capabilities

### 1. Media & Compression Tools
- [Media Tools Hub](https://tableview.dev/media-tools): Client-side video and image compression studio powered by WebAssembly. Zero uploads, no watermarks.
- [Free Online Video Compressor](https://tableview.dev/video-compressor): Compress MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV client-side via FFmpeg WebAssembly. No watermark, no artificial upload limits, custom target MB compression (e.g., Discord 25MB, WhatsApp 16MB).
- [Batch Image Compressor](https://tableview.dev/image-compressor): Batch compress JPG, PNG, WebP images locally with side-by-side visual preview, compression ratio sliders, and 1-click ZIP export.

### 2. Financial & Real Estate Debt Calculators
- [Financial Calculators Hub](https://tableview.dev/finance-calculator): Institutional real estate debt, mortgage, and personal finance modeling suite.
- [DSCR Loan Calculator](https://tableview.dev/dscr-loan-calculator): Debt Service Coverage Ratio underwriting for commercial and rental property portfolios with qualification tier analysis.
- [Commercial Loan & Balloon Calculator](https://tableview.dev/commercial-loan-calculator): Commercial mortgage modeling with 5/7/10-year balloon maturity balances and 20-30 year amortization schedules.
- [IRC §1031 Exchange Calculator](https://tableview.dev/section-1031-exchange-calculator): Like-kind tax-deferred real estate exchange modeling, boot calculation (cash and mortgage relief), and replacement basis tracking.
- [Fixed-Rate Mortgage & Amortization Calculator](https://tableview.dev/mortgage-calculator): 30-year/15-year fixed loan amortization, PMI cancellation, extra principal acceleration, and escrow tracking.
- [Refinance Break-Even Calculator](https://tableview.dev/refinance-calculator): Refinancing cost-benefit analysis and payback period modeling.
- [Hard Money & Fix-and-Flip Calculator](https://tableview.dev/hard-money-calculator): 70% rule Maximum Allowable Offer (MAO), renovation draw schedule, and net ROI analysis.
- [Loan Comparison & APR Analyzer](https://tableview.dev/loan-comparison-calculator): Side-by-side loan scenario analysis and discount point break-even matrix.
- [Salary to Hourly Wage Calculator](https://tableview.dev/salary-to-hourly-calculator): 2,080-hour annual compensation conversion with FLSA overtime (1.5x/2.0x) rules.

### 3. In-Browser Data Workbench & FinOps
- [Data Tools Workbench](https://tableview.dev/data-tools): DuckDB-Wasm SIMD analytical SQL console for millions of rows.
- [Universal Data Converter](https://tableview.dev/data-converter): Convert datasets between Apache Parquet, Excel (.xlsx), CSV, and JSON 100% in-browser with ZSTD compression.
- [CSV Spreadsheet Viewer](https://tableview.dev/csv-viewer): Sort, filter, and inspect massive CSV/TSV files with zero server egress.
- [Apache Parquet Viewer](https://tableview.dev/parquet-viewer): In-browser column inspection and SQL querying for .parquet and .geoparquet files.
- [Excel (.xlsx) Viewer](https://tableview.dev/excel-viewer): Preview multi-sheet Excel workbooks locally.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://tableview.dev/json-formatter): Format, validate, and minify hierarchical JSON and NDJSON.
- [SQL Formatter & Minifier](https://tableview.dev/sql-formatter): Format dialect-aware SQL queries client-side.
- [Snowflake Cost Calculator](https://tableview.dev/snowflake-cost-calculator): FinOps warehouse credit and storage expenditure forecasting.
- [Parquet Storage Calculator](https://tableview.dev/parquet-storage-calculator): Estimate compression savings moving from CSV/JSON to Apache Parquet.

## Technical Architecture & Privacy Guarantees
- Zero Server Storage: 100% of processing happens in browser memory via WebAssembly (Wasm) and Web Workers.
- Air-Gapped Ready: Operates offline without sending data to external servers or cloud APIs.
- Export Formats: Excel (.xlsx), CSV, WebM, MP4, JPEG, PNG, WebP.
